analysis:
docs/reports/README.md (head lines 1-260): documentation index only. It adds a Bonsai 9B publication link at line 7. Base lines 229-258 shift to head lines 231-260 with the same links. This adds no security-control changes.

scripts/test_model_registry_workflow.py (added, 140 lines) is a unittest that extracts run blocks from .github/workflows/register-model.yml. It executes the steps 'Build revision-only payload', 'Build registration payload' and 'Publish model with coordinator' via bash against a loopback HTTP fixture (127.0.0.1, ephemeral port). It strips AWS_/R2_ environment variables (line 57-58) and uses a fixture bearer key.

The tests assert the following:
- Revision-only mode posts only version and hugging_face_artifact to /v1/admin/models/{id}/publish-revision (line 86).
- A malformed artifact JSON or an empty publishing key never posts (lines 108-128).
- HTTP 503 makes the step fail (line 115-120).
- The workflow contains no secrets.R2_ or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID references (lines 134-135).

The workflow YAML itself was not supplied. This is a coverage limit; the test reflects the intended workflow behavior.

Integration should check register-model.yml:
- Whether MODEL_REGISTRY_PUBLISHING_KEY is scoped to the workflow_dispatch environment.
- Whether workflow inputs (MODEL_ID, VERSION, the JSON inputs) are passed via env rather than interpolated into shell (${{ inputs.* }} injection).
- Whether the publish-revision path URL-encodes MODEL_ID.
- Whether COORDINATOR_URL is pinned to an https production host.

Model registry/catalog publication is backend/admin scope. It is out of scope for the provider threat model, beyond the catalog/weight-hash concerns in T-012, T-027 and SEC-007; the test pins the HF revision to a 40-hex value. No provider runtime, attestation, encryption or authorization code changed.
